accident_report: V1 (Vehicle A) is traveling eastbound in Lane 1 (rightmost lane), initially 15 meters ahead of V2 which is also traveling in Lane 1. V2 (Vehicle B) is traveling eastbound in Lane 1, 15 meters behind V1. V3 (Vehicle C) is traveling westbound initially in Lane 5 (leftmost lane for westbound), moves into Lane 4 and enters the center turn lane, preparing to make a left turn. V4 (another vehicle) is traveling eastbound in Lane 2, 20 meters ahead of V1, makes a right turn which makes V1 suddenly visible to V3. V1 is in Lane 1 traveling eastbound, and V2 follows 15 meters behind in the same lane. V3 travels westbound in Lane 5, makes a lane change to Lane 4, and then enters the center turn lane designated as Lane 3. A large truck (V4) is in Lane 2 and is 20 meters ahead of V1, obstructing V3's view until V4 makes a right turn. Once V4 turns right, V3 sees what it believes is a gap and starts making a left turn across the eastbound lanes (Lanes 1 and 2). V1, which was following closely behind V4, now comes into the path of V3’s left turn. V1 collides with V3 as V3 makes a left turn from the center turn lane (Lane 3), crossing into Lane 1. V2 may brake in time and might make a near-miss or could be part of a secondary collision with V1 either hitting V1 if V1 stops suddenly or swerves.
